crossRefs.note: twenty bowls of gold weighing one thousand darics; and two vessels of fine bright bronze, precious as gold.
On the fourth day the silver and the gold and the vessels were weighed in the house of our God into the hand of…
everything by number and by weight; and all the weight was written at that time.
They spoke of the God of Jerusalem as of the gods of the peoples of the earth, which are the work of men’s hands.
At that time they will call Jerusalem ‘Yahweh’s Throne;’ and all the nations will be gathered to it, to Yahweh’s name…

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: The vessels that are given to you for the service of the house of your God, deliver before the God of Jerusalem.
translations.bsb: You must deliver to the God of Jerusalem all the articles given to you for the service of the house of your God.
translations.kjv: The vessels also that are given thee for the service of the house of thy God, those deliver thou before the God of Jerusalem.
translations.asv: And the vessels that are given thee for the service of the house of thy God, deliver thou before the God of Jerusalem.
